title: Shared definitions
description: Types reused across every entity. Nothing here is an entity in its own right.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Stable for the life of the record — renaming one breaks saved student plans.

intake.description: The admission cycle an Opportunity begins in, e.g. 2027-autumn.

applicantGroup.description: Who a rule applies to. 'any' means the rule does not vary by group.

verificationState.description: Our confidence that the evidence is current and supports the claim. Not a claim about truth.

coordinatePrecision.description: How precisely the coordinates locate the thing. A city-centre fallback must never be drawn as an exact campus.

danishLevel.description: Danish upper-secondary subject level. A is highest. These are levels of study, not grades. This is a real scale and the name is accurate, so it stays — but nothing generic may refer to it. A requirement names its scale in `levelScale` and the scale is defined by a Recognition Scheme; see docs/adr/0002-the-ib-scale-is-the-lingua-franca.md.

consequence.description: What actually happens if a milestone is missed. 'hard' means the door closes.

evidenceRef.description: Reference to an Evidence record id.

evidenceRefs.description: Every consequential claim should carry at least one.

localisedText.description: Official wording kept verbatim alongside a plain-English rendering.

official.description: True when this is the source's exact wording.
